In 2025, the fictional Northstar region installed 120 megawatts of rooftop solar, up from 100 megawatts in 2024. Installations are measured as new capacity, not electricity generated.

draft_memo.title: Online Grocery Adoption and Delivery Reliability in Northstar
draft_memo.body:
In 2025, 600 of 1,000 respondents in Northstar reported buying groceries online, compared with 520 of 1,000 in 2024, showing an increase in online grocery adoption [P07]. The same 2025 online grocery survey found that 360 of 600 online buyers valued delivery reliability most [P08]. The survey did not ask respondents to rank every purchasing factor, which limits the understanding of the importance of delivery reliability compared to other factors [P08]. The total number of respondents in the survey was 1,000, but the survey does not provide details on how many of those were repeat buyers or first-time users [P07]. The increase in online grocery buyers from 2024 to 2025 is notable, but the survey does not provide insights into the reasons behind this growth [P07]. Additionally, the survey does not specify the demographics of the respondents, which could influence the results [P07]. The survey's focus on respondents rather than transaction volumes means that it does not capture the full picture of online grocery shopping trends [P07]. The survey results do not include information on the frequency of online grocery purchases among respondents [P07].

Interpretation: The data shows an increase in online grocery adoption and a strong preference for delivery reliability among buyers.

Limitations: The survey does not provide transaction volume data, which limits the assessment of actual purchasing behavior. It also lacks insights into the reasons for the increase in online grocery buyers. Furthermore, the absence of a ranking system for purchasing factors restricts the understanding of how delivery reliability compares to other factors. The survey is based on self-reported data, which may not accurately reflect actual shopping habits. The survey does not account for demographic variations among respondents. Lastly, the survey does not clarify whether the respondents were first-time users or repeat buyers.
footnotes: [P08] 2025 online grocery survey: delivery reliability preferences.
[P07] Northstar online grocery survey: buyer statistics, 2025.
